title: Turtle Soup on 1h: failed 20-day-low sweep reclaimed within 3 bars, buy the stop run

source.title: Turtle Soup
source.license: Free to use with attribution (LuxAlgo Library)

rule_summary: Closed 1h candles only, signals at bar close, order at next bar open. Let PL = lowest low of the 480 bars (20 days) before bar t-3, and require that this low was set at least 96 bars (4 days) before bar t. SWEEP: within bars t-3..t, at least one bar low is below PL. RECLAIM: close(t) > PL and close(t-1) <= PL or the sweep occurred on bar t itself with close(t) > PL (first reclaim close only). ENTRY at close of t when sweep and reclaim hold and no position is open. Let S = the lowest low over bars t-3..t. EXIT at the first close >= the highest high of the 24 bars ending at t (target), or after 48 bars from entry, or at a close below S (stop, checked on closed bars). One entry per sweep; no re-entry for 24 bars after exit.
mechanism: Stop orders of longs and breakout sellers cluster just under a well-known 20-day low. Price is pushed through, the stops trigger forced selling, and once that supply is gone and price closes back above the level, there is no follow-through, so the move snaps back. The other side is the breakout seller who sold the failed break. The source gives no evidence or mechanism beyond the pattern description; this is the closest honest one. The rebound toward the 24h high is typically several percent, above the 0.35% cost.
